reasoning: The icon is an abstract UI action glyph showing a diagonal arrow entering a circle (representing input, import, or login) rather than a concrete object or activity. At small sizes in a to-do list, it is easily mistaken for an external link/export arrow or a compass, making it poor as a glanceable subject reminder.
